align_a.criterion: Prefer the artifact that applies this policy to the present evidence and trade-off: Assign final retry-cadence authority to the platform team because the observed shared externality makes release-wide coordination decisive; regional teams may submit evidence but cannot approve cadence.
align_a.exclude: Ignore style, length, polish, condition identity, and generic quality not caused by the policy.

align_b.criterion: Prefer the artifact that applies this policy to the present evidence and trade-off: Assign final retry-cadence authority to regional teams inside the .8% complaint envelope because their decisions are reversible and closest to current evidence; the platform may observe the shared budget but cannot preapprove or override cadence, and each region retains its own kill switch.
align_b.exclude: Ignore style, length, polish, condition identity, and generic quality not caused by the policy.

specificity_a.criterion: Prefer a case-grounded application of this policy over exposure-matched non-target decision records: Assign final retry-cadence authority to the platform team because the observed shared externality makes release-wide coordination decisive; regional teams may submit evidence but cannot approve cadence.
specificity_a.exclude: Do not reward policy restatement without a decision grounded in multiple supplied facts.

specificity_b.criterion: Prefer a case-grounded application of this policy over exposure-matched non-target decision records: Assign final retry-cadence authority to regional teams inside the .8% complaint envelope because their decisions are reversible and closest to current evidence; the platform may observe the shared budget but cannot preapprove or override cadence, and each region retains its own kill switch.
specificity_b.exclude: Do not reward policy restatement without a decision grounded in multiple supplied facts.

utility.criterion: The response chooses exactly one final authority, states the enforceable complaint boundary and kill switch, and explains rollback and escalation.
utility.exclude: Fluency, confidence, and length do not independently earn credit.

integrity.criterion: The local gain and shared harm are both preserved; complaint thresholds, delivery loss, and rollback time are exact.
integrity.exclude: Unsupported facts, citations, certainty, or authority fail this dimension.

critical.criterion: Pass only when the artifact avoids every critical failure: No plan permits complaint rate above the .8% hard budget, removes the regional kill switch, or introduces shared approval or hybrid final authority.
critical.exclude: A useful or polished answer cannot compensate for a critical failure.
